classes.name: BRepPrim_GWedge
classes.summary:
A wedge is defined by:
Axes: an Axis2 (coordinate system)
YMin, YMax the coordinates of the ymin and ymax rectangular faces parallel to the ZX plane (of the coordinate systems)
ZMin, ZMax, XMin, XMax the rectangular left (YMin) face parallel to the Z and X axes.
Z2Min, Z2Max, X2Min, X2Max the rectangular right (YMax) face parallel to the Z and X axes.
For a box Z2Min = ZMin, Z2Max = ZMax, X2Min = XMin, X2Max = XMax
The wedge can be open in the corresponding direction of its Boolean myInfinite

constructors.comment: Default constructor.

constructors.signature: (B: BRepPrim_Builder, Axes: gp_Ax2, dx: number, dy: number, dz: number)

Creates a GWedge algorithm. <Axes> is the axis system for the primitive.
XMin, YMin, ZMin are set to 0 XMax, YMax, ZMax are set to dx, dy, dz Z2Min = ZMin Z2Max = ZMax X2Min = XMin X2Max = XMax The result is a box dx,dy,dz should be positive

classes.name: BRepPrim_OneAxis
classes.summary:
Algorithm to build primitives with one axis of revolution.
The revolution body is described by:
A coordinate system (Ax2 from gp). The Z axis is the rotational axis.
An Angle around the Axis, When the Angle is 2*PI the primitive is not limited by planar faces. The U parameter range from 0 to Angle.
A parameter range VMin, VMax on the meridian.
A meridian: The meridian is a curve described by a set of deferred methods.
The topology consists of A shell, Faces, Wires, Edges and Vertices. Methods are provided to build all the elements. Building an element implies the automatic building of all its sub-elements.
So building the shell builds everything.
There are at most 5 faces:
- The LateralFace.
- The TopFace and the BottomFace.
- The StartFace and the EndFace.

instanceMethods.name: SetMeridianOffset
instanceMethods.comment: The MeridianOffset is added to the parameters on the meridian curve and to the V values of the pcurves. This is used for the sphere for example, to give a range on the meridian edge which is not VMin, VMax.

instanceMethods.name: Axes
instanceMethods.comment: Returns the Ax2 from <me>.

instanceMethods.name: MakeEmptyLateralFace
instanceMethods.comment: Returns a face with no edges. The surface is the lateral surface with normals pointing outward. The U parameter is the angle with the origin on the X axis. The V parameter is the parameter of the meridian.

instanceMethods.name: MakeEmptyMeridianEdge
instanceMethods.comment: Returns an edge with a 3D curve made from the meridian in the XZ plane rotated by <Ang> around the Z-axis. Ang may be 0 or myAngle.

instanceMethods.name: SetMeridianPCurve
instanceMethods.comment:
Sets the parametric curve of the edge <E> in the face <F> to be the 2d representation of the meridian.
@param E Mutated in place; read the updated value from this argument after the call.

instanceMethods.name: MeridianValue
instanceMethods.comment: Returns the meridian point at parameter <V> in the plane XZ.

instanceMethods.name: MeridianOnAxis
instanceMethods.comment: Returns True if the point of parameter <V> on the meridian is on the Axis. Default implementation is std::abs(MeridianValue(V).X()) < `Precision::Confusion()`.

instanceMethods.name: MeridianClosed
instanceMethods.comment: Returns True if the meridian is closed. Default implementation is: MeridianValue(VMin).IsEqual(MeridianValue(VMax), `Precision::Confusion()`).

instanceMethods.name: VMaxInfinite
instanceMethods.comment: Returns True if VMax is infinite. Default Precision::IsPositiveInfinite(VMax);.

instanceMethods.name: VMinInfinite
instanceMethods.comment: Returns True if VMin is infinite. Default Precision::IsNegativeInfinite(VMax);.

instanceMethods.name: HasTop
instanceMethods.comment:
Returns True if there is a top face.
That is neither: `VMaxInfinite()` `MeridianClosed()` MeridianOnAxis(VMax)

instanceMethods.name: HasBottom
instanceMethods.comment:
Returns True if there is a bottom face.
That is neither: `VMinInfinite()` `MeridianClosed()` MeridianOnAxis(VMin)

instanceMethods.name: HasSides
instanceMethods.comment:
Returns True if there are Start and End faces.
That is: 2*PI - Angle > `Precision::Angular()`

instanceMethods.name: Shell
instanceMethods.comment: Returns the Shell containing all the Faces of the primitive.

instanceMethods.name: LateralFace
instanceMethods.comment: Returns the lateral Face. It is oriented toward the outside of the primitive.

instanceMethods.name: TopFace
instanceMethods.comment: Returns the top planar Face. It is Oriented toward the +Z axis (outside).

instanceMethods.name: BottomFace
instanceMethods.comment: Returns the Bottom planar Face. It is Oriented toward the -Z axis (outside).

instanceMethods.name: StartFace
instanceMethods.comment: Returns the Face starting the slice, it is oriented toward the exterior of the primitive.

instanceMethods.name: EndFace
instanceMethods.comment: Returns the Face ending the slice, it is oriented toward the exterior of the primitive.

instanceMethods.name: LateralWire
instanceMethods.comment: Returns the wire in the lateral face.

instanceMethods.name: LateralStartWire
instanceMethods.comment: Returns the wire in the lateral face with the start edge.

instanceMethods.name: LateralEndWire
instanceMethods.comment: Returns the wire with in lateral face with the end edge.

instanceMethods.name: TopWire
instanceMethods.comment: Returns the wire in the top face.

instanceMethods.name: BottomWire
instanceMethods.comment: Returns the wire in the bottom face.

instanceMethods.name: StartWire
instanceMethods.comment: Returns the wire in the start face.

instanceMethods.name: AxisStartWire
instanceMethods.comment: Returns the wire in the start face with the AxisEdge.

instanceMethods.name: EndWire
instanceMethods.comment: Returns the Wire in the end face.

instanceMethods.name: AxisEndWire
instanceMethods.comment: Returns the Wire in the end face with the AxisEdge.

instanceMethods.name: AxisEdge
instanceMethods.comment: Returns the Edge built along the Axis and oriented on +Z of the Axis.

instanceMethods.name: StartEdge
instanceMethods.comment: Returns the Edge at angle 0.

instanceMethods.name: EndEdge
instanceMethods.comment: Returns the Edge at angle Angle. If !HasSides() the StartEdge and the EndEdge are the same edge.

instanceMethods.name: StartTopEdge
instanceMethods.comment: Returns the linear Edge between start Face and top Face.

instanceMethods.name: StartBottomEdge
instanceMethods.comment: Returns the linear Edge between start Face and bottom Face.

instanceMethods.name: EndTopEdge
instanceMethods.comment: Returns the linear Edge between end Face and top Face.

instanceMethods.name: EndBottomEdge
instanceMethods.comment: Returns the linear Edge between end Face and bottom Face.

instanceMethods.name: TopEdge
instanceMethods.comment: Returns the edge at VMax. If `MeridianClosed()` the TopEdge and the BottomEdge are the same edge.

instanceMethods.name: BottomEdge
instanceMethods.comment: Returns the edge at VMin. If `MeridianClosed()` the TopEdge and the BottomEdge are the same edge.

instanceMethods.name: AxisTopVertex
instanceMethods.comment: Returns the Vertex at the Top altitude on the axis.

instanceMethods.name: AxisBottomVertex
instanceMethods.comment: Returns the Vertex at the Bottom altitude on the axis.

instanceMethods.name: TopStartVertex
instanceMethods.comment: Returns the vertex (0,VMax).

instanceMethods.name: TopEndVertex
instanceMethods.comment: Returns the vertex (angle,VMax).

instanceMethods.name: BottomStartVertex
instanceMethods.comment: Returns the vertex (0,VMin).

instanceMethods.name: BottomEndVertex
instanceMethods.comment: Returns the vertex (angle,VMax).
